text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Sudden drowsiness detected due to
failing
operation "sheep count."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. For some reason, the
method my
father taught me is not
executing effectively.
choice_data_list: 眠れるまで羊を数えるやつか？
眠れるまで羊を数えるやつ？
choice_data_list_en: Like counting sheep until you fall asleep?
Like counting sheep until you fall asleep?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
A sheep does one leg press, and
proceeds onto
two forward lunges.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Once the sheep completes 21,600 hip

extensions, it's time to wake up.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, considering the burden on the
sheep,
perhaps swimming would have
been a better
choice of exercise.

In her own way, she seems genuinely
concerned
about her inability to sleep.
